These both seem like very good requirements. Either version of 4.2.2 seems reasonable.

4.2.3 also seems very sensible as a REST type requirement. If I do not need to support a certain verb, blocking it seem best. In know we cover this elsewhere (like disabling functionality not being used) but this is a nice specific requirement for API dev's.

Now supporting 4.2.3 can lead to attacks like verb tunneling in certain frameworks. Leaving TRACE on is an old school vulnerability. There are a lot of other reasons to close verbs at the webserver level that you are not using in the app.
